Question: Harold made a plum pie to take on a picnic. He was able to eat only \(\frac{1}{4}\) of the pie, and he left the rest for his friends. A moose came by and ate \(\frac{1}{3}\) of what Harold left behind. After that, a porcupine ate \(\frac{1}{3}\) of what the moose left behind. How much of the original pie still remained after the porcupine left?
